source_caption_text:
Came up outta that dirt pile, now I’m ballin’

The melody in “All In” is one of the first things that stands out. Built around a melancholic acoustic guitar progression, the song opens with a soft, almost haunting feeling before the slow trap production settles underneath it. The simplicity of the guitar gives YoungBoy’s vocals plenty of room to carry the emotion.

Released on YoungBoy Never Broke Again’s 2020 album Top, “All In” brings together Yung Lan, LC, and SephGotWaves for the production. The contrast between the delicate guitar melody and heavier drums creates a dark, atmospheric sound that fits the emotional weight of the song. YoungBoy’s melodic delivery adds another layer to the production, making the track feel especially personal.

The guitar melody also helps give “All In” its lasting appeal. Even with the heavy subject matter, the instrumental remains smooth and memorable, creating a sound that fans can instantly recognize. It is a strong example of how YoungBoy could take a simple melody and turn it into an emotional centerpiece.
